items.title: Eliashib and Tobiah the Ammonite
items.charge: Preparing for Tobiah the Ammonite a great chamber in the court of the house of God, where the offerings, the frankincense, the vessels, and the tithes of the Levites had been laid; a grandson of the high priest son in law to Sanballat the Horonite

items.title: Hymenaeus, Alexander, and Philetus
items.charge: Making shipwreck of the faith; blasphemy; teaching that the resurrection is past already

items.title: Jason the high priest
items.charge: Buying the priesthood; setting up a Greek gymnasium; drawing his countrymen to heathen customs

items.title: Shebna the treasurer
items.charge: Hewing himself a sepulchre on high in the rock, as if Jerusalem were his to be buried in; a shame to his lord’s house

items.title: The builders of Babel
items.charge: Building a city and a tower under Nimrod, to make themselves a name and be one people, lest they be scattered abroad

items.title: The Corinthian who had his father’s wife
items.charge: Fornication not so much as named among the Gentiles: a man with his father’s wife
